subject: Onsite demo coordination — Crestline Labs (June 26)
content:
From: Olivia Hart <olivia.hart@crestlinelabs.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Lowe <sarah.lowe@crestlinelabs.com>, it@crestlinelabs.com
Date: Mon, 18 Jun 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Onsite demo request — Redwood @ Crestline (June 26)

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for the quick call last week. Wed like to bring a small cross-functional group to Redwoods Novato HQ for a hands-on demo and to validate the Dedicated offering against a real workload.

Proposed window: Wednesday, June 26 — arrival between 10:00 and 11:00, demo run 11:30–14:30, followed by a short Q&A and lunch. Attendees: Olivia Hart (Product), Sarah Lowe (IT lead), two data engineers, one security manager.

Two quick asks before we lock the calendar:
- Do you require us to sign an NDA on arrival, or can we e-sign ahead of time?
- Well need guest badging for five people + one external hardware vendor who will drop off a demo device briefly.

Ive attached a preliminary badge list and our standard NDA. Can you confirm availability and room options?

Thanks,
Olivia Hart
Head of Product, Crestline Labs
olivia.hart@crestlinelabs.com

---

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Hart <olivia.hart@crestlinelabs.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jun 2028 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onsite demo request — Redwood @ Crestline (June 26)

Hi Olivia — great to hear; wed love to host you. Quick confirmations below and a compact agenda proposal.

Agenda (proposed)
- 11:00 — Welcome / badging / quick intro (Lobby)
- 11:30 — Architecture + model serving deep-dive (Conf Room A, North Building Hub)
- 12:15 — Live demo: Dedicated capacity + failover / routing policies (Conf Room A)
- 13:00 — Lunch (on-site) + open Q&A (Breakout B)
- 13:45 — Security/compliance checklist walk-through (Security room / 30 mins)
- 14:15 — Next steps & close

Logistics notes:
- We can e-sign the NDA ahead of time (DocSend link below) or accept a signed copy on arrival; e-sign is faster for check-in.
- Badge plan: we provide temporary visitor badges for lobby access; for the external hardware vendor, we need the vendors name and company and whether they will need network access.
- AV: projector + HDMI, laptop dongles available; Jordan will confirm breakout room availability.
- Parking: limited—please flag if guests need reserved spots.

Attachments: Ive attached our Redwood visitor playbook (room map) and a sample agenda; please send a final attendee list for badging.

Possible room: North Building Hub (Conf Room A) is preferred for screen+network. Jordan, can you block that room for 11:00–15:00 on June 26 and confirm AV + capacity? Ben, can you advise whether we should request a temporary network VLAN for the vendor device for 30–60 minutes?

If the 11:30 start is tight on travel, we can shift to 12:00 start and compress demos.

Thanks — excited to host.
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.com

---

On Mon, Jun 18, 2028 at 10:24 AM Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com> wrote:

> Stephanie / Olivia —
>
> Ive tentatively reserved North Building Hub (Conf Room A) for 11:00-15:00 on Jun 26 and flagged for AV: projector, HDMI + Mac adapters, conference mics (we have the setup for a hybrid recording if needed).
>
> Capacity is 12 seated + 6 stand-by. Breakout B is available for lunch/Q&A (small round tables).
>
> Ill attach the room map and a quick AV checklist to the invite. Olivia, if you want an alternate quieter room for the security walk-through, Conf Room C is free 13:30-15:00.
>
> —Jordan
>Facilities & Events, Redwood
>
---

From: Olivia Hart <olivia.hart@crestlinelabs.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Sarah Lowe <sarah.lowe@crestlinelabs.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Jun 2028 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onsite demo request — Redwood @ Crestline (June 26)

Thanks — that works overall. A couple of adjustments from our side:
- Can we move the demo start to 12:00 so two of our engineers can catch an earlier client call? That would make the run 12:00–15:00.
- We will e-sign the NDA today; you should see a DocSend/DocuSign link coming from our legal team by EOD.
- Vendor: Mateo Ruiz (Ruiz Embedded) will drop off a preconfigured USB device at ~10:15 and wont stay for the session. He will need short-term network egress to validate device reachability (no inbound).
- Parking: please reserve one accessible spot and two visitor spaces near the north entrance.

Attached: updated badge list (crestline-badge-list.csv) and the vendor statement.

Olivia

---

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Hart <olivia.hart@crestlinelabs.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jun 2028 14:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onsite demo request — Redwood @ Crestline (June 26)

Hi Olivia — quick network note and confirmation: we can provide temporary outbound-only VLAN access for Mateos device for a 45-minute window, monitored by our infra team. Please share the device MAC and the IP range it needs to reach (or a hostname). We will:

- Schedule the VLAN window: 10:00–11:00 (prep) and re-enable for 12:00–12:45 if you want validation during the demo.
- Confirmed parking: one accessible + two visitor spots near North Entrance.
- NDA: we received the DocSend link; signed copy attached (NDA_Crestline_Redwood_signed.pdf).

Ive updated the calendar invite to start at 12:00 and extended to 15:00. Jordan: please keep Conf Room A 11:00–15:00 for setup / teardown.

See you all on the 26th — final attendee list is set.

Ben Carter
Infrastructure Lead, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Attachments referenced in thread: crestline-badge-list.csv, north-building-hub-room-map.png, NDA_Crestline_Redwood_signed.pdf
